title: Open Problems in Mechanics
subtitle: A curated map of theoretical challenges in solids, structures, and materials
description: A curated, evolving map of theoretical mechanics problems that connects physical significance, mathematical formulation, known boundaries, settlement criteria, and documented progress.
focus: The initial collection focuses on solid mechanics, structural mechanics, and mechanics of materials. The scope can expand through well-motivated community contributions.
initiative: We identify a small set of physically consequential mechanics questions and make the theoretical target, known/open boundary, settlement criteria, and progress explicit. The collection is a personal research initiative designed to make difficult mechanics frontiers easier to evaluate, contribute to, and revisit as theory, experiments, computation, and AI-assisted research evolve.
author: Bo Ni · GenMech Lab
